name: Trebujena (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Trebujena (a tree with a bird on green) between eight yellow fleurs-de-lis.
history: Municipal flag of Trebujena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Trebujena arms — tree with a bird on green
eight fleurs-de-lis in a ring around the arms
